source.method: Static callsite extraction from the loaded webpack bundle plus Chrome Network traces. Request bodies, cookie values, tokens and response data were not retained.

auth.transportEvidence: Axios baseURL=api/v1, withCredentials=true and withXSRFToken=true. Captured API requests carry Cookie and X-XSRF-TOKEN header names; no Authorization header was present.

endpoints.purpose: Obter cookies CSRF antes do login, registro e redefinição de senha.
Login com email, password, version e hcaptcha_token; o frontend lê data.user.
Solicitar email para redefinição de senha.
